scriptWriters.effect: TEMP-set sugar per_unit_metric.value then restored to hard-coded 0.00145 (lines 74, 102) — value may differ from the pre-test original

query.rule: POST https://google.serper.dev/shopping {q: `${name} price`, gl:'gb', location:'United Kingdom'}; `name` = canonical_name (weekly_price_refresh.js:57, no query_alias used)

blocklist.rule: source containing these is never a supermarket; NO title/keyword blocklist exists in the old code

packParse.rule: WEIGHT_VOLUME_RE /(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s?(kg|g|l|ml|cl)\b/i -> g_or_ml (kg,l x1000, cl x10); MULTIPACK_RE /(\d+)\s?(?:pack|x|×)\b/i multiplies qty; no weight but multipack -> {qty:N, unit:'each'}; EACH_RE /\beach\b/i -> {1,'each'}; else null. Falls back to canonical_ingredients.reference_pack (source_of_pack='reference').

aggregate.rule: per_unit = price/pack.qty (rounded 4dp); per dimension (g_or_ml vs each) separately: trimOutliers (n>=5 -> drop 1 lowest + 1 highest) then median; confidence high(>=3 listings & any per_unit) / low(>=1 & per_unit) / price_only(>=1) / none; cheapest = lowest `price` listing (NOT per-unit).

retry.rule: up to 3 attempts (backoff 0/300/600ms) while n_supermarkets == 0 -> up to 3 credits per doc

upsert.rule: all non-quarantined canonicals; `$set` whole cacheDoc (listings, per_unit_*, cheapest, confidence, needs_review, metadata{source:'serper',query_used,reference_pack_used,raw_listing_count,attempts,fetched_at}) with upsert — overwrites hand curation and writes no previous values

oldRules.kitchenSinkWarning: Serper `price` is the *shown* price; no unit-price field is used. Titles are never checked against the ingredient (hence seeds / supplements / multipacks slipping in).
